'''Asha''' was a fierce huntress in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology. "Asha" was a popular name for female [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Asha/Legends|the Ewok warrior]] and daughter of [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]].<ref name="Ewoks">{{Ewoks|Asha (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Asha was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
